verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Insomnia's MCP Client connects external MCP servers and discovers their tools, prompts, and resources. Users can then invoke, query, or test them directly in the app (insomnia-docs-46, insomnia-docs-30), and a further doc mentions MCP clients connecting Insomnia to Konnect (insomnia-docs-14). The tools are invoked inside Insomnia's client UI; the evidence does not show an in-product AI agent calling them on its own. Missing for 10: details on supported transports and auth, evidence of autonomous agentic tool use rather than manual invocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
